description: Trigger: admin endpoint GET /status calls build_log_tip_json which executes SELECT MAX(sequence_number), cid FROM group_log WHERE group_name = ?. SQLite does not aggregate cid — it returns an arbitrary row's cid rather than the cid belonging to the max-sequence row. Bad behavior: /status reports a stale or random CID as the group log tip, breaking any consumer that uses the tip CID for traversal or replication.
title: build_log_tip_json returns arbitrary cid for max-sequence row
